description_en: You can invoke BargeInCall to forcibly insert into an ongoing call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. After the forced insertion succeeds, the original two-party call becomes a three-party conference call
description_zh: 调用BargeInCall强行插入指定实例下指定通话ID对应的正在通话中的通话，强插成功后，通话将由原来的双方通话变成三人会议
kebab_example: aliyun ccc barge-in-call --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --job-id job-65382141036850000 --barged-user-id agent2@ccc-test --timeout-seconds 60 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BargeInCall

parameters.help_en: Agent ID initiating the force insert
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled in with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: Agent ID whose call was barged in on
parameters.name: barged_user_id

parameters.help_en: Timeout for force insert, in seconds. If the force insert operation does not succeed within the specified time, it is canceled. Normally, the force insert operation succeeds immediately. The timeout setting is provided to handle abnormal scenarios. This field is optional and defaults to 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 强插超时时间，经过指定的时间强插仍未成功，则取消强插，正常情况下，强插操作会马上成功，设置超时时间是为了防止异常发生，此字段选填，默认30，单位秒
parameters.name: timeout_seconds
